requested_scope: New project; complete production replacement following Claude humanoid source-frame playbook. No attack animation or weapon.
artistic_acceptance: not_selected: user requested restoring the original Claude model on 2026-10-13

references_hd.origin: Reused original generated HD masters, not previous geometry or rig
references_hd.agent_review: All five full-size views inspected against original five-view sprite sheet. Matching identity, A-pose, 5 digits per hand, hem stripes, nape hair, shoe shape; alpha inspected on white. Original imagegen bytes retained.

design_decisions.user: she does not need to have attack animation at all
design_decisions.effect: Omit Attack and native attack-only dagger

design_decisions: Native sprite timings remain evidence, while the listed local/library production clips use their selected durations. No native reconstruction claim. Artistic acceptance remains with the user.
next_action: Retain this project separately. User is reviewing the restored original Claude model.

Standing.adaptation: Upright neutral; author lightly clasped hands below belt from native stance.

Walking.adaptation: Relax forward walk; shortened stride, rigid grounded soles, 15 degrees additional arm abduction to clear the closed skirt.

Hit.adaptation: Standing pelvis and planted legs; recoil and hand separation, recovery into Standing.

Death.adaptation: Converted Mixamo world rotations into the fitted B_* source frames; standing entry, restrained leg flex, feet anchor the footprint, legs extend into the native prone corpse; whole-body ground contact and enclosed-skirt drape.

Fidget.adaptation: Subtle head glance, clasped hands and planted soles.

run.reason: Native speed 140 is below running threshold; no sprint necessary.

g1.notes: Source mannequin front/profile/three-quarter; ROM at source times retained; authored adaptations tested on actual rig later.

geometry_cleanup.budget_reduction: Deferred until after skin weighting; protect face and hands

rig_fit.notes: New body/hand geometry and locally replaced weights; source frames and fitted hands. Four arm twist controls, 72 skirt controls, two braid controls replace two unused toe end bones. 128 bones total.

deformation_before_reduction.notes: G4 arm p99 <=1.62 at selected ROM extrema; G5 every clip max <=3.44; no G6 hand contact over 2 mm. Cloth checked separately in work/skirt_gate.json.

reduced_geometry.notes: Five moving clips at half frames. Closed one generated cloth puncture, extended neckline overlap and omitted permanently covered upper legs. Original full geometry and intermediate checkpoints preserved.

references_head.review: Matches the selected body identity: brown middle-part hair, narrow circlet, modest face; contact sheet inspected.

correction_ledger.finding: Body Smart Topology generated two nape tails
correction_ledger.change: Replaced the split ends with one compact plait/tie/tuft before rigging

correction_ledger.finding: Face eyelid and nostril surface folds persist after gentle local cleanup
correction_ledger.resolution: Separate generated head surface fitted/projected onto retained body head. Clean face colour baked from head-model UVs; native skin tone retained around neckline.

correction_ledger.finding: Generated extra/fused fingers and malformed original hand silhouettes
correction_ledger.change: Separate five-digit hand generation, mirrored/fitted hands, measured finger frames and new weights.

correction_ledger.finding: Closed skirt followed legs poorly during locomotion and forward fall
correction_ledger.change: Dedicated cloth chains, fitted prone drape, two contact-clearance passes, coincident seam weight matching.

correction_ledger.finding: Brief wrist/finger crossings during Walking and Death entry
correction_ledger.change: Fixed-length arm rotations: total additional 15-degree walking abduction and a short outward/forward Death-entry detour.

correction_ledger.finding: Braid crossed the neck during Hit and Death
correction_ledger.change: Two fitted braid controls with a back-directed fall trajectory, replacing unused toe end bones without increasing the 128-bone budget.

correction_ledger.finding: Hair paint on exposed back panel, wrist pigmentation, poor returned mouth shading
correction_ledger.change: Explicit skin classification/toning, clean head-model face bake, correct normal-map convention; no paid regeneration.

correction_ledger.finding: Default LOD builder kept eight influences instead of the project four-influence budget
correction_ledger.change: Added optional --max-influences (default eight unchanged), rebuilt this project at four and checked normalized weights at all LODs.

rig_seed.reuse: Owned Meshy same-family rig provides independent initial joint and weight estimates only; current new Smart Topology geometry retained and source B_* frames fitted locally.
rig_seed.reason: New full-skirt rig request returned HTTP422 Mechoux pose estimation; no charge.

hand_component.reason: Full-body generation produced six digits and irregular palms; corrected local cleanup still failed close-up anatomy review. Separate new Smart Topology component, mirrored and fitted to real cuff sections.
